text: Great quality body pillow cover!!!. The cover is made of good quality fabric, its thick and soft! The stitching is also done well. product_metadata.title: Oubonun 100% Cotton Body Pillowcase - 800 Thread Count/21x54, Moisture Absorbent and Breathable, Premium Hotel Body Pillow Cover for All Seasons, Light Blue
features: Luxury Hotel Pillowcase: Experience the comfort of sleeping on a cloud with our high-quality pillowcase. Suitable for 20x54 or 21x54 body pillow. Tip: The package does not include body pillow insert!

Suitable for All Seasons: Our pillowcases are breathable and highly absorbent. When you sweat, there is a temperature difference between the inside and outside of cotton, which allows it to absorb moisture from the inside and release it outward, taking away heat and providing a cooling effect. These pillowcases are not only cool in summer but also have great insulation properties. Cotton fibers have low thermal conductivity, making it difficult for accumulated heat on fabric to dissipate.

High moisture absorption: This characteristic can roughly determine whether the material is cotton or synthetic fiber. The secret lies in the hollow cotton fibers. Its cross-section has a shape of many arranged hollow beads, forming many tiny pores to accommodate water molecules.When exposed to water, they quickly penetrate and spread, allowing cotton fibers to absorb and retain a large amount of moisture.

Easy to Use: Our pillowcase features an 8-inch envelope closure design on the short side. This no-zipper design eliminates the worry of zipper damage or discomfort. Safe for machine washing and extends the lifespan of the pillowcase.

Care Instructions: Please note that cotton pillowcase is not suitable for high-temperature drying or ironing, as it may result in shrinkage or a scratchy texture. We recommend washing with warm or cold water and air drying or using a low heat setting in the dryer, as it helps maintain the softness and texture of the fabric effectively.
